title: PUT /v1/assets/{asset}/register request body
description: Record what the installation team read on site about a unit (work.evidence or field.scan): hostname, IPv4 address, MAC, firmware, mounting location. Each write is a new version (the history is who touched the unit); a hostname, address or MAC current on another unit in service is refused (409); a non-networked device class takes none of the three; a retired unit takes no entry.
